text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A wreath arrives from Eishin Flash's 
parents to celebrate her debut with 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by the wreath, the Trainer 
learned of her respect for her parents—and 
the immense weight that "righteousness" 
held for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her obsession with the Japanese Derby 
stemmed from a simple desire to make her 
beloved mother proud. The motive behind 
her rigorous efforts was a pure and humble 
one.
